commits.message:
fix(tree): hideRoot drops its children's column; ASCII ends a list with `--; one walk entry (rich-tree-sgk)

Review of PR #188 (high):
- hideRoot now takes the root row and the column its children hang from, as
  Rich does (levels[2:]), via the single _walk entry render and measure share.
- ASCII end glyph is "`-- ", as in Rich.
- The stacking test uses italic rather than bold, so it no longer pins the
  light-glyph/bold-guide divergence ticketed as rich-tree-te3h.

fix(tree): a branch on every row at every depth, and a multi-line label stays behind its guides (rich-tree-sgk)

Grandchildren were walked with only the continuation prefix, so rows below
the first level lost their branch glyph and guide style. One recursion now
walks every depth; each guide column carries its first-line and continuation
glyph and the stacked guide styles of the nodes above it, as in Rich.

A label rendering several lines printed its later lines at column 0 and a
blank row after; the label is now cut into lines and each is led by the
guides.

fix(export-html): wide glyphs hold two cells; CJK example on the Text page (rich-docs-examples-xuu.9lc) (#187)

* fix(export-html): a wide glyph holds its two cells, so columns after CJK text line up (rich-docs-examples-xuu.9lc)

docs/text.md gains a Wide characters example: a Table of CJK and Hangul
city names. Checked in a browser, its column edges drifted up to 24px left on
rows with wide text, because a browser draws a wide glyph at its fallback
font's width, not two cells. encodeHtmlFragment now cuts a run at each
grapheme that is not one cell wide and draws it as a run of its own in an
inline-block exactly that many ch wide.

* fix(export-html): box only wide glyphs, unpainted, inside their run; fix the fragment's default line height

A wide glyph's box now carries only its width and inherits its parent's
decoration, so the run's background and lines stay the run's and the markup
grows by one short span per wide glyph. Zero-width graphemes stay in the text,
all-ASCII runs skip segmentation, and the segmenter is made on use rather than
at import. The fragment's fallback font now fixes its line height, so a row
holding a fallback-font glyph no longer grows.

* fix(export-html): one box per stretch of wide glyphs, and one grapheme segmenter

Find-in-page does not match across two inline-blocks, so a CJK word boxed a
glyph apiece could not be searched; a stretch of wide glyphs now shares one box
as wide as their cells together, and a zero-width grapheme joins the stretch
before it. The segmenter is made once, on first use.
